mechanism.claim: A robust second-half versus first-half median return shift is more likely broad price discovery when the actual BTC spot auction exhibits the same signed location shift as the perpetual; follow the common shift for eight hours during frozen high variation.
mechanism.side: immutable HVMRSR-8 side, emitted only when spot median shift has the same strict sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVMRSR is perpetual-only. Cash/perpetual candidates use endpoint returns, ranges, basis, flow, or lead-lag. HVCVMRS compares the signed median of 240 one-minute open-to-close returns in each half independently on both actual venues and uses no endpoint direction, volume, flow, OI, funding, premium, options, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: cross-venue robust return-location consensus at irregular HVMRSR events is absent from Gross9

construction.primary: immutable HVMRSR-8 event, side, entry, and hold
construction.spot_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance_spot BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
construction.spot_shift: median rows 240..479 log(close/open) minus median rows 0..239
construction.confirmation: spot_shift strict nonzero and sign equals immutable perpetual median-shift side

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence
research_boundary.selection_basis: independent spot confirmation of robust within-auction location shift

stopping_rule: source, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no primary, spot source, half partition, median, sign agreement, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
